python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.DataGridToolBar(%PARENT%)
model = QStandardItemModel(2, 3, control)
model.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Project", "Owner", "Status"])
model.setItem(0, 0, QStandardItem("FluentQt"))
model.setItem(0, 1, QStandardItem("Ada"))
model.setItem(0, 2, QStandardItem("Open"))
model.setItem(1, 0, QStandardItem("Gallery"))
model.setItem(1, 1, QStandardItem("Lin"))
model.setItem(1, 2, QStandardItem("Closed"))
grid = fluentqt.DataGrid(control)
grid.setModel(model)
grid.hide()
control.setDataGrid(grid)
control.searchField().setPlaceholderText("Search projects...")
control.addFilter("status", "Status", ["Open", "Closed"])

description.en: Provides search, facet filters, and DataGrid column visibility, ordering, and pinning controls.
description.zh: 提供搜索、多维筛选，以及 DataGrid 列的显隐、排序和固定控制。
